description: Log your baby's weight and height over time and see a growth log with typical-range guidance.

faqs.a: Rough medians: birth ~3.3 kg/50 cm, 6 months ~7.9 kg/67 cm, 12 months ~9.6 kg/75 cm. Every baby grows at its own pace.
No — this is a simple log with rough reference bands, not a WHO percentile chart. Your pediatrician's chart is the authority.
Log a measurement every few weeks; more often is unnecessary and can cause needless worry.
Growth concerns are best judged by your pediatrician across proper percentile charts — ask at the next visit.

howto: Enter your baby's date of birth once.
Log each measurement: date, weight, height.
Watch the growth table fill in over time.
Read the typical-range note — then confirm with your pediatrician.
title: Baby Growth Tracker
